sourceRanges.use: Shared trigger/tag/popup declarations; category-specific320px list, native switcher/indentation and title hover.
Native-parent tree construction only; no synthetic parent rows.
Original non-strict SHOW_PARENT/standaloneALL behavior is inspected, not blindly applied to an incomplete native candidate page.

nativeContract: Existing authorized bounded category candidates and positive categoryIds. A selected native parent means its whole server-defined branch. No new query API, schema, table, permission or write changes in this shared-control checkpoint.
reuse: Existing shared TreeSelect trigger/tag/lazy-style/ownership shell is unchanged for flat consumers. Opt-in category-branches uses the installed public Tree leaf through TreeSelect.dropdownRender to keep canonical tag IDs separate from projected known-child checks. No private TreeList cloning or component registry.
intentionalDifferences: Strict selection with explicit canonical branch IDs instead of source non-strict SHOW_PARENT on a complete catalog. No halfchecks or completeness inferred from a partial candidate page.
Only real current loaded parents are nested; an absent parent is not fetched, injected or invented. Provider-owned orphan labels are preserved.

ALL is independent from every explicit positive category ID; it may include uncategorized rows. Its standalone projection checks only ALL. Checking one ordinary node replaces ALL with exactly that positive ID; false/uncheck callbacks still refuse ALL-minus even for a complete page. Positive IDs never normalize to unrestricted[].
A child already included by a selected parent cannot be individually excluded. A separate deliberate positive-only action may replace the branch. No exclusion API or loaded-window approximation.
Removing an explicit redundant child tag removes only that canonical token; the child remains visually covered by its selected native parent.
Disabled candidates cannot be newly added; retained explicit disabled tokens remain removable.
Known malformed parent cycles/self-links/unsupported depth fail closed visibly. No inference is made about unobserved ancestors.
verificationBoundary: Pure model tests, real installed TreeSelect/Tree in synthetic JSDOM, source hashes and static CSS/graph checks only. No real-browser pixels/layout, performance, DB, production, or full frozen-Demo semantic parity acceptance.
